newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Honko Int'l offers 67 mln shrs at HK$1.0 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's Honko Int'l offers 67 mln shrs at HK$1.0 each.

text.p: Transistors and diodes maker and distributor Honko International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it plans to issue 67 million new shares, representing 25 percent of the company's expanded share capital, at HK$1.0 per share in an initial public offer.
One free warrant will be attached for every five shares subscribed, the company added.
The public offer will be from Tuesday to Friday. Dealing in shares is expected to begin on October 14, the company said.
The proceeds would be used to expand its production facilities, it asid.
Honko which makes diodes and transistors, engages in the sourcing and distribution of diodes, transistors and capacitors.
It posted a net profit of HK$43.1 million for the year ending March 31, 1996, up 29 percent from the previous year. Turnover was HK$807.6 million, up 52 percent a year earlier.
Standard Chartered Asia Ltd is the sponsor and underwriter of the new issue.
